name: Pull-Up
summary: A bodyweight vertical pull with an overhand grip that builds the lats, upper back and arms. A benchmark of relative upper-body strength.
setup: Grab the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder width.
Hang with arms fully extended, ribs down and glutes lightly squeezed.
Cross or bend the legs behind you so they do not swing.
execution: Start by pulling the shoulder blades down and back.
Drive the elbows down toward your ribs until your chin clears the bar.
Pause briefly with the chest high and the body in a straight line.
Lower under control until the arms are fully straight again.
mistakes: Kipping or swinging: brace the abs and glutes and slow each rep down.
Half reps from a bent-arm start: begin every rep from a full hang.
Craning the neck over the bar: keep the head neutral and bring the bar to you.
Shrugging the shoulders to the ears: pull the shoulder blades down before bending the elbows.
